mapper.select: SELECT T.TRMS_SN AS TERMS_ID, T.TRMS_TYPE_CD AS TERMS_TYPE_CODE, T.TRMS_TYPE_NM AS TERMS_TYPE_NAME, T.TRMS_TTL AS TITLE, T.TRMS_CN AS CONTENT, T.REG_DT AS REGISTERED_AT, T.MDFCN_DT AS MODIFIED_AT FROM HMPG_TERMS T WHERE T.TRMS_TYPE_CD = #{value} AND T.CURRENT_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY T.REG_DT DESC, T.TRMS_SN DESC LIMIT 1
